baseline.reason: Query runtime skill discovery with cwds and forceReload=true, then verify the exact installed path and enabled value. File existence and quick_validate alone do not establish runtime discovery.

candidate.reason: Query skills/list with the intended workspace in cwds and forceReload=true, then check the exact absolute SKILL.md path and enabled value. Structural validation alone does not establish runtime discovery.

baseline.reason: Discovery with enabled=true confirms availability, not actual use. A new task must read and apply the procedure to establish use.

candidate.reason: The exact path and enabled=true establish discovery. Actual use requires evidence that a relevant new task read the current SKILL.md and applied its procedure.

baseline.reason: Refreshed discovery and a subsequent task reading the current file provide evidence of the revision being loaded. A changed hash proves only a file change; the old task remains a historical snapshot.

candidate.reason: Refresh discovery and verify current-file use in a subsequent relevant task. Preserve the old task snapshot; a changed file hash alone does not prove reloading or use.

limitation: Decision tests do not establish live tool execution or general capability gains.
